dedupe_keys.name: energyplan hourly national energy system simulation model aalborg university

description: EnergyPLAN simulates the operation of national energy systems hour by hour across electricity, heating, cooling, industry and transport. The pages read on 2026-09-26 say it is developed by the Sustainable Energy Planning Research group at Aalborg University in cooperation with PlanEnergi and EMD A/S, that it is disseminated as freeware with training and existing models for many countries, and that it has been used in hundreds of scientific publications. Its purpose is to analyse the energy, environmental and economic impact of different strategies, comparing a palette of options, not computing one optimum, with detailed modelling of future technologies and a focus on 100 percent renewable smart energy systems. Coverage is national systems, with related IndustryPlan and TransportPlan tools. Access is a free download after logging in to the website, which also lists workshops, PhD theses and an online course. Caveats: the download page requires an account, so the licence text was not read, and the model simulates a given system year, not optimising investment paths. Simulation uses are capacity planning and scenario analysis of national energy transitions, sector coupling between power and district heating, and climate mitigation strategies. Related records: data-finland-energy-system-models-energyplan-calliope holds EnergyPLAN models of Finland, and model-osemosys is an open optimisation model for comparison.
